tasks.subject: Exchange programme
tasks.text: …Great news: our school is starting an exchange programme with a school in Spain, and I've decided to apply! My parents aren't sure that it's a good idea. What do you think are the advantages of studying abroad for a short time? Have you ever stayed with a host family? What would you like to see in a foreign country? By the way, I've just joined a drama club…
